Class DeckController

java.lang.Object
com.dami.tcg.controller.DeckController
@Controller public class DeckController extends Object
Controller responsible for handling deck-related HTTP requests.

Manages the creation, deletion, viewing, and editing of player decks. All deck operations require the player to be authenticated via the HTTP session. Unauthenticated users are redirected to the login page.

Author:
Brayan, Adam, Oihan and Asier

    • showDeckCreate

      @GetMapping("/deckcreate") public String showDeckCreate(org.springframework.ui.Model model, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession session)
      Handles GET requests to /deckcreate and displays the deck creation form.

      Retrieves the logged player's available cards and their quantities to populate the deck creation view.

      Parameters:
      model - the Model used to pass data to the view
      session - the HttpSession containing the logged player's information
      Returns:
      the name of the view template ("deckcreate"), or a redirect to /login if the player is not authenticated

    • insertDeck

      @PostMapping("/deckcreate") public String insertDeck(org.springframework.ui.Model model, org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.support.RedirectAttributes redirectAttributes, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession session, @ModelAttribute Deck deck)
      Handles POST requests to /deckcreate and processes deck creation.

      Associates the new deck with the authenticated player and persists it to the database. Displays success or error flash messages accordingly.

      Parameters:
      model - the Model used to pass data to the view
      redirectAttributes - the RedirectAttributes used to pass flash messages
      session - the HttpSession containing the logged player's information
      deck - the Deck object bound from the form submission
      Returns:
      a redirect to /player on success, /deckcreate on failure, or /login if the player is not authenticated

    • deckDelete

      @GetMapping("/deckdelete") public String deckDelete(org.springframework.ui.Model model, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession session, @RequestParam int deckId, org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.support.RedirectAttributes redirectAttributes)
      Handles GET requests to /deckdelete and deletes a deck by its ID.

      Removes the specified deck from the database and redirects to the deck list with a success or error flash message.

      Parameters:
      model - the Model used to pass data to the view
      session - the HttpSession containing the logged player's information
      deckId - the ID of the deck to delete
      redirectAttributes - the RedirectAttributes used to pass flash messages
      Returns:
      a redirect to /deckcheck, or /login if the player is not authenticated

    • deckCheck

      @GetMapping("/deckcheck") public String deckCheck(org.springframework.ui.Model model, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession session, Deck deck, org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.support.RedirectAttributes redirectAttributes)
      Handles GET requests to /deckcheck and displays the player's deck list.

      Retrieves all decks belonging to the authenticated player. If no decks exist, a message is displayed to the user.

      Parameters:
      model - the Model used to pass data to the view
      session - the HttpSession containing the logged player's information
      deck - the Deck object (bound from request parameters)
      redirectAttributes - the RedirectAttributes used to pass flash messages
      Returns:
      the name of the view template ("deckcheck"), or a redirect to /login if the player is not authenticated

    • deckView

      @GetMapping("/deckview") public String deckView(org.springframework.ui.Model model, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession session, org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.support.RedirectAttributes redirectAttributes, @RequestParam int deckId)
      Handles GET requests to /deckview and displays the contents of a specific deck.

      Retrieves the deck by ID and resolves the full card details for each card in the deck. If the deck is empty or not found, redirects to the deck list with an error message.

      Parameters:
      model - the Model used to pass data to the view
      session - the HttpSession containing the logged player's information
      redirectAttributes - the RedirectAttributes used to pass flash messages
      deckId - the ID of the deck to view
      Returns:
      the name of the view template ("deckview"), a redirect to /deckcheck if the deck is empty, or /login if the player is not authenticated

    • deckEdit

      @GetMapping("/deckedit") public String deckEdit(org.springframework.ui.Model model, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession session, org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.support.RedirectAttributes redirectAttributes, @RequestParam int deckId)
      Handles GET requests to /deckedit and displays the deck editing form.

      Retrieves the deck by ID and resolves the full card details for editing. If the deck is empty or not found, redirects to the deck list with an error message.

      Parameters:
      model - the Model used to pass data to the view
      session - the HttpSession containing the logged player's information
      redirectAttributes - the RedirectAttributes used to pass flash messages
      deckId - the ID of the deck to edit
      Returns:
      the name of the view template ("deckedit"), a redirect to /deckcheck if the deck is empty, or /login if the player is not authenticated
